ModMetaData.name: Local Mineral Scanner
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description: Never strip-mine again. Adds a local mineral scanner, a compact 2x2 building that a pawn operates to reveal undiscovered mineral deposits on the current map. It can be tuned to a specific mineral type, and two pawns can operate it together to scan faster. Optionally, it can also find ancient cryptosleep caskets.
